title: Laboratory Test Orders — Test Directory and Chargemaster Prices by Service Class
content:
Every test on a Laboratory Test Orders accession is priced from the test menu of the accession's own service class. Each menu is the single source of every per-test price: the **list price** is the chargemaster price in US dollars, and the **self-pay price** is the published patient-pay price in US dollars. Fasting is given in hours; "none" means the test needs no fasting.

## Reading the directory

- **Which price is which?** The list price is the chargemaster amount; the self-pay price is the published amount for a patient paying directly. The two are separate columns of the same menu entry, and neither is derived from the other.
- **Which tests need fasting?** Reading the fasting column across every class: the Lipid Panel (7600) and Vitamins A and E (36169) need a 12-hour fast, the Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (10231) an 8-hour fast, and every other test listed needs none.
- **Example (hypothetical lookup).** A Routine Clinical Testing accession carrying the Hemoglobin A1c and the Vitamin B12 shows 48.00 and 71.00 as their list prices and 33.00 and 41.00 as their self-pay prices.
